note:
SIOG's screening-tools update, Decoster 2015, and still one of SIOG's two listed formal references for geriatric assessment. This is where the G8 cutoff comes from -- the threshold `rules/referrals.py` fires on at G8 <= 14 and cannot yet be believed, because no loaded guideline supported it. Loading this is what licenses that rule.

Corpus v4.0 routes all 81 of its passages to `general_principle`, and this file agrees: nothing in a paper about which screening instrument to use is about a disease stage.

No rules at all. Its bibliography -- 64 of its 102 headings -- is marked by stage 1 rather than by a rule, because a rule matches a heading it can name and there is no naming sixty-four citations.

default.note: Which instrument, at what cutoff, for whom. True at every stage of every cancer. Serves screening, risk_stratification throughout: Which geriatric screening instrument to use and at what cutoff -- screening in order to stratify, which is why it carries both.
